sections.name: summary
sections.value: Conversations become first-class indexed content (req-0024..0027): agent and human conversations are stored turn-by-turn, anchored to a repo location, enriched through the EXISTING summarize/embed lanes, and queryable through the standard surface -- semantic search over turns, then a windowed fetch (-10/+20 style) around any hit. Workshop 005 (docs/plans/prd/workshops/005-conversations.md) is AUTHORITATIVE for every design decision: tables, measured turn payload, scope. V1 ships storage, intake surface, an import verb, and the query dims; live capture hooks and rollup summaries are explicitly out.

value.claim: An imported conversation JSONL lands via flowspace3 conversation import, its turns are queryable rows, and re-importing the same file changes nothing (idempotent on conversation_id+turn_no)
Turn payloads honour workshop 005: prose and tool inputs verbatim, write-family inputs stored as path+byte-length, tool outputs as 512B head + total_bytes + truncated flag, thinking absent

Turns at/above the size gate get a smart summary and both embeddings through the EXISTING lanes; below-gate turns embed raw only; a fake-provider test proves both paths and the dedupe (identical turns = one enrichment)
search --source conversation returns turn hits carrying conv:<guid>#t<ord> addresses with one-line context, never blended into code results by default
A windowed fetch around any turn (before/after counts caller-chosen) returns the contiguous slice in order, honest at conversation edges
Every turn carries source (human|peer|system) and head_sha; the conversation carries repo/worktree/base_sha anchor; both are visible in query output
remove/gc leave conversations intact (anchors are pointers not ownership) and conversation-derived content participates in the three-level GC rules unchanged
value.note: Store half proven in phase 1: removing_the_anchored_repo_leaves_the_conversation_intact and a_conversation_no_worktree_holds_survives_a_full_gc_sweep (mutation-checked). Daemon/CLI half follows in phases 2-3.

value.claim: End-to-end dogfood proof: a real fleet transcript imported, searched, and windowed -- transcript of the run recorded as the plan exit evidence
A conversation grows iteratively: posting/importing new turns to an existing conversation appends only the delta, enqueues enrichment only for new turns, and never disturbs stored ones

conversation list (with --repo/--path anchor filters) and conversation remove <guid> exist as JSON-envelope verbs; remove deletes the conversation, its turns and elements, and a following gc reclaims its unshared enrichment

value.title: Store: conversation tables + turn payload + windowed reads
value.brief: Everything below the daemon: the conversations migration (take the NEXT FREE number on freshly-pulled main at implementation time -- 0010/0011 landed in PR 24 and w-update-truth takes 0012), the two ref-layer tables, the elements bridge that makes turns first-class content, and the second reference leg so conversation content survives the spend guard and GC.
value.note: Landed in PR #30 (7a2dd8a, 4ca5421) on b3a5889. Gate: fmt + clippy -D warnings clean, pg_conversations 13/13, one seal-caused config_loading failure accounted for (env override wins over a config FILE by design; passes 10/10 unsealed). Mutation-checked GC survival. Production database verified untouched at migration 12. Two plan corrections landed with it: the anchor is TEXT with no FK (ruled), and turn elements need the reserved parser_version conversation/1.

value.title: Daemon: intake endpoint + enrichment through existing lanes
value.brief: The daemon half: a POST /conversations intake endpoint (append-friendly, idempotent on conversation_id+turn_no, payload policy ENFORCED at intake -- 512B output heads, write-family path+length, per workshop 005), enrichment enqueue through the EXISTING summarize/embed lanes with the size gate, and proof that remove/gc leave conversations intact while conversation content follows normal three-level GC.
value.note: Landed in PR #31 (310ac0e, ed0d660) stacked on phase 1. Gate green except the known seal-caused config_loading failure. Carried an unplanned production fix: a phase-2 test exposed that level-0 GC deleted every pending embed job (payload->>raw_hash is NULL for a batch job), silently leaving content unsearchable; fixed across both vector spaces with a schema-derived boot recovery sweep, ruled in by o-prime as belonging to this PR.

value.title: CLI: import verb + conversation query surface
value.brief: The user surface: flowspace3 conversation import (JSONL, first client of the intake endpoint), search --source conversation implemented as a CONTENT-TYPE filter (elements.kind) orthogonal to the raw|smart vector axis -- resolving workshop 003 OQ1 -- with conv: addresses on hits, the windowed fetch around a turn, the turn outline, docs, service page, and the live dogfood proof (a real fleet transcript imported and searched) as exit evidence.
